Lutron LEAP Bridge — Custom Savant profile for HomeWorks QSX and RadioRA 3.
This profile connects to the savant-lutron-bridge service running on the Savant Pro Host via HTTP on port 47200. HTTP is used (instead of TCP 8023) so that Savant can serialize bleColor data from the color wheel into URL query parameters — something TCP command strings cannot do.
Setup: 1. Install and run savant-lutron-bridge on the Pro Host Mac Mini 2. Open http://localhost:47200 to pair with the Lutron processor 3. In Blueprint, set the Address/Host to 127.0.0.1, Port to 47200 4. Use the Lighting Data Table — Address1 = LEAP Zone ID (shown in web UI) 5. Use the Shade Data Table — Address1 = LEAP Zone ID (shade zones)
Address fields: Lighting/Shade table: Address1 = LEAP Zone ID Keypad Button entity: Address1 = LEAP Device ID, Address2 = Button Number, Address3 = LED ID (from Keypads tab in web UI)
State Variables: SystemType — QSX or RA3 (informational; bridge auto-detects) FadeTime — default fade time in seconds for switch on/off actions
Note on status feedback: This profile uses HTTP (request-response). Push feedback from physical keypads requires the bridge TCP port 8023 to be added as a separate monitoring connection in Blueprint if needed. For most use cases, the optimistic state updates in each action are sufficient.
====================== Change Log ====================== Version 1.12 Add: ReportProfileVersion tells SplycedBoard which profile version Savant runs, so its dashboard can warn when the profile is out of date. Fix: http_request_type moved onto command_string, where Savant's schema defines it. Version 1.11 Fix: HVAC commands use GoToDualSetPointParameters with nested DualSetPointParameters; thermostat state variables get unique_identifier="ThermostatID" so Savant can bind per-instance state to the thermostat screen. Version 1.8 Add: Palladiom thermostat support via ENV_HVACCONTROLLER_SOURCE. Version 1.9 Fix: fan modes corrected to High/Medium/Low (removed Circulate); add state variables and actions for all three. Version 1.10 Fix: add QueryDimmerLevel response parsing and query_status_with_action polling so physical keypad changes reflect in Savant app. HVAC endpoints: /api/hvac/status, /api/hvac/heat, /api/hvac/cool, /api/hvac/mode, /api/hvac/fan. Address1 = LEAP HVAC controller ID. Version 1.7 Test: Added DMX entity (DimmerSet + CurrentColor valueSource) to test whether Savant populates bleColor* args for DMX entity type. DimmerSet now includes bleColor* args and routes to /api/color. Version 1.6 Fix: Renamed entities to match Blueprint data table conventions: "Ketra Color" → "Color Slider" (Type RGBW), "Tunable White" → "CCT Slider" (Type WW). Fixed valueSource names: CurrentBleColor → ColorLevel, CurrentColorTemperature → CCTLevel. Version 1.5 Change: Migrated from TCP (port 8023) to HTTP (port 47200). All commands now use HTTP GET with query parameters. bleColorRed/Green/Blue/White now serialize correctly in URL params, enabling Ketra color wheel support. /api/color and /api/cct endpoints added to bridge. All other endpoints (zone, area, shade, scene, button) added as GET variants on port 47200. Version 1.4 Fix: RFDimmerSet sends #COLORSET with bleColor data over TCP. Version 1.3 Fix: Replaced linear Color/Vibrancy slider with color wheel. Version 1.1 Fix: resource_type attributes, shade #SHADEGRP, fan controller. Version 1.0 Initial release.
